archive.catalogue_description: Description This is my take on the son’s of anarchy garage and club house, son’s of zombie anarchy include’s all zombies are runners custom textures weapon camo’s and zombie skins all waw and bo1 perks (mull kick, quick revive and jug all fixed and working) bank with interest hidden shootable door hiding a weapons room, and pap wall guns buy-able, max ammo, insta kill and 2x’s points buy-able, ending zombie counter custom cz75 starting gun bo1 weapons; MP5 MAC11 PM63 SKORPION RPK M16 AK47 UZI AUG FNFAL FAMAS ENFIELD GALIL All bo1 weapons come with custom skin thanks goes to, ZK- for his tut’s n123q45- for beta testing, script and mapping help and pool table’s rounded corner’s stopsign43- beta tester bamskater33- black ops perk and scripts joeybbb- skin collection quizz- waw pack-a-punch skins cinnober- stair pefab with path nodes treminaor- bank JR-Imagine- zombie counter have fun hope you all enjoy the map, happy slaying!!!

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
